activation.title: Activate your app
activation.description: Enter the activation code you received, or scan its QR code.
activation.scanPhoto: Take a photo of the QR code
activation.codeHint: 12 letters and numbers, printed below the QR code.
activation.noCode: No code? Ask the company or dealer who gave you this app.
activation.offline: You are offline. Turn on the internet to activate the app.

success.title: App activated
success.generic: Your app is ready to use.

scanner.title: Scan the QR code
scanner.hint: Hold the QR code inside the frame.
scanner.notActivationQr: This is not an activation QR code.
scanner.cameraUnavailable: The camera could not be opened. Type the code, or take a photo of the QR code.
scanner.photoNotRead: No activation QR code was found in the photo. Try again, or type the code.

errors.activation_invalid: This code is not correct. Check it and enter it again.
errors.activation_used: This code has already been used. Ask for a new code.
errors.activation_revoked: This code has been cancelled. Ask for a new code.
errors.activation_expired: This code has expired. Ask for a new code.
errors.activation_tenant_inactive: This code cannot be used right now. Contact the company that gave you the code.
errors.activation_subscription_inactive: The company's plan is not active right now. Contact the company that gave you the code.
errors.activation_capacity_full: All licences of this company are in use. Contact the company that gave you the code.
errors.activation_farmer_invalid: This account cannot be activated. Please sign in again.
errors.activation_failed: The app could not be activated. Please try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many wrong codes. Try again after {{minutes}} minutes.
errors.transport_unavailable: Network connection is weak. Please try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
